# gitmoap_repository_tag (Data Source)

Get a tag by name. The tag with the commit it points to and, for an annotated tag, its tagger and message. Anyone who can read the repository's code may call it, without signing in on a public repository.

The token needs `tag:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_repository_by_path" "api" {
  full_path = "acme/platform/api"
}

data "gitmoap_repository_tag" "api" {
  repo_id  = data.gitmoap_repository_by_path.api.repository_id
  tag_name = "v1.0.0"
}
```
